commit_message: Complete Timeline Audio Track adapter on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete Timeline Audio Track adapter
pr_body:
## Summary

- complete ADR 0126 Audio Track start/stop/seek/fade through ADR 0122 managed voices
- keep spatial playback on the existing ADR 0122 mixer path
- restore audio exactly at clip-local cursor offsets on seek
- preserve runtime-local voice identity and existing authoring/serialization contracts
- include focused Audio Track seek/fade/stop regression tests

Visual Validation is not required because this change is runtime/audio composition logic only.
